resources.string: Faka lusuku lwe-Hijri kute utfole emalanga e-Arafah, e-An-Nahr kanye ne-Tashreeq
Faka lusuku lwe-Hijri kute ubone emalanga e-Arafah, e-An-Nahr kanye ne-Tashreeq
Faka lusuku lweHijri lolusebentako. Umnyaka kusuka ku 1300 kuya ku 1600, inyanga kusuka ku 1 kuya ku 12, lilanga kusuka ku 1 kuya ku 30.

Faka noma nguliphi lilanga le-Hijri (noma ugcine lilanga lamanje) kute utfole ngekushesha emalanga e-Hajj emnyaka wayo: Lilanga le-Arafah (9 Dhul-Hijjah), Lilanga le-An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjah) kanye nemalanga e-Tashreeq (11, 12 kanye ne-13 ijjah-Hijjats), sikhundla lesihlobene nelusuku lwakho.
Insika lenkhulu: yima eArafah kusukela ngemuva kwemini kuze kube sekushoneni kwelilanga, wenta kuncenga lokuningi, takbir kanye ne tahlil. Umphrofethi (PBUH) watsi: "I-Hajj yi-Arafah."
Eid al-Adha: litje Jamarat al-Aqabah ngematje lasikhombisa, nikela ngemhlatjelo, uphuce noma usike, bese wenta iTawaf al-Ifadah ne Sai.
Satiso semalanga onkhe lesikukhumbuta ngemkhosi lohlosiwe ngesikhatsi sawo ngesikhatsi semalanga eHajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)

I-sunnah yalelilanga: ngena ihram, inhloko eMina bese uchitsa busuku lapho, uphindzaphindza iTalbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", bese uthandaza lapho ufinyetiwe ngaphandle kwekuhlanganisa.
Litje lama Jamarat lamatsatfu ngemuva kwemini: lamancane, bese lasemkhatsini, bese lamakhulu, ematje lasikhombisa ngamunye ngesikhatsi asho takbir, ancusa ngemuva kwalawo lamancane nalasemkhatsini.

Phindza ugcobe ngematje emaJamarat lamatsatfu ngemuva kwemini njengayitolo. Nobe ngubani lofisa kuphutfuma angaphuma eMina lingakashoni lilanga; lohlalako uhlala busuku bonkhe futsi udvonsa ematje ngelilanga lesitsatfu.
Litje le Jamarat lemitsatfu ngemuva kwemini, bese uphetsa iHajj nge Tawaf yekuvalelisa uma uphuma eMakkah. Kwangatsi Allah angakwemukela iHajj yakho.

Inkhomba lephelele ye Hajj ne Umrah: inchazelo kanye nemitsetfo, tinhlobo temasiko, i mawaqit, emasiko sinyatselo ngesinyatselo ngekuhlakanipha kwabo kanye naloko lokufanele bakusho esiteshini ngasinye, kuvinjelwa kwe ihram, kanye nekuncenga. Khetsa sigaba lofisa kusihlola.

Imitsetfo yekuzila, tintfo letiyicedzako kanye nema-sunnah
Kusuka ekuvakasheleni labagulako kuya ekugezeni, ekungcwabeni nasekudvudvuteleni
Umhlahlandlela lophelele: emasiko sinyatselo ngesinyatselo, kuhlakanipha kwawo, kanye nekuncenga .
Umbiko jikelele longatsatsi luhlangotsi wemaphuzu emehluko
Emagama langemashumi lasiphohlongo nemfica kanye nenshokutsi yawo .
Yini lephula kugeza nemthandazo, futsi yini lengaphuli
Kukholelwa ku Allah, tingelosi takhe, tincwadzi, titfunywa, Lilanga Lekugcina kanye nemtsetfo waNkulunkulu .
Imithantazo yekutitsandzela lecinisekisiwe ngaphambi nangemuva kwaleyo lebophekile .
Umthandazo sinyatselo ngesinyatselo, kusuka ku-takbir kuya ku-taslim
Kucala nekuphela kwemthandazo ngamunye walemihlanu yemalanga onkhe .
Timo tayo, nisab kanye netigaba letisiphohlongo tebemukeli .

Umphrofethi صلى الله عليه وسلم watsi: “Allah unemagama langemashumi lasiphohlongo nemfica, likhulu ngaphansi kwalinye; noma ngubani lowabala utawungena ePharadesi.” Thepha noma nguliphi ligama kute ufundze inchazelo yalo lephelele, inchazelo kanye nebufakazi lobuvela ku-Quran.
